purpose: Common contract of the review mechanism: round flow, hand-off by review_id and round_number, finding_id numbering, exit values, the review body duties, and the JSON data structures.
summary: Review flow: body drives rounds with reviewer then evaluator until termination, then deletes retained items
FNC-302 to FNC-305: hand-off by identifiers only, scripts assemble input, values unchanged, request immutable during review
FNC-317: request carries no target type; the receiving side determines it
FNC-313: finding_id is numbered by script as one sequence per review shared by reviewer and evaluator
FNC-310 and FNC-311: write after judgments are fixed; exit value as string with closed error set; abnormal ends detected by missing value
FNC-203: every finding_id must be referenced by some evaluation, guaranteed at write time
FNC-312, FNC-316, FNC-318: body duties, retains_context branching, termination conditions, final decision by the body
DM-301 to DM-305: request, result, finding, evaluation structures, disposition, severity, confidence, and absolute path and location notation
tasks: Implementing or changing the review skill body
Writing reviewer or evaluator agent definitions
Implementing review exchange scripts for requests and results
Changing JSON structures of request, finding or evaluation
Designing termination or round progression of reviews
Handling agent error or abnormal termination in review
title: REQ-029 review 機構の共通契約 要件定義書
